name: A Dream That Changes Everything
source:
I grew up in a quiet town, spending my days with my best friend, Michelle. Life was simple and happy. But when my dad passed away, everything changed. My mom struggled, and I did my best to help. Now, at 18, I’ve finished high school, but jobs here are hard to find. An opportunity came from Michelle, who now lives in Alivara. She had space for me to stay, a chance for something new. I hesitated, but in the end, I packed my bags and left. Want to know the rest of the story? Play the game now!

[From [url=https://pjoygames.itch.io/a-dream-that-changes-everything-final]itch[/url]]
translation:
我在一个安静的小镇长大，和我最好的朋友米歇尔一起度过了时光。生活简单而幸福。但当我父亲去世后，一切都改变了。妈妈很辛苦，我也尽力帮忙。现在，我18岁了，高中毕业了，但这里的工作很难找。一个机会来自现在住在阿里瓦拉的米歇尔。她为我提供了停留的空间，给了我尝试新事物的机会。我犹豫了一下，但最终还是收拾好行李离开了。想知道故事的其余部分吗？现在就玩游戏吧！

[来自[url=https://pjoygames.itch.io/a-dream-that-changes-everything-final]itch[/url]]
